steps.speaker: Aldric
steps.title: Welcome to the Warehouse
steps.body:
Everything your heroes bring back from the dungeon ends up here — materials, equipment, potions, the lot. I keep it organized so you don't have to.

Your stash has limited space, so sell what you don't need at the shop. Materials stack up to 100 per slot in your stash, but only 20 per slot in hero bags — so let me hold the bulk.

steps.speaker: Aldric
steps.title: Upgrades & Capacity
steps.body:
More shelf space costs gold — visit the Upgrade tab when your stash starts getting cramped. Each tier means sturdier shelving and better organization, so I can fit more without things falling apart.

You can also manage your heroes' equipped gear from here. Handy for swapping weapons between runs.
